why: First Tier 3 seeding slice after the ticket 1 purge. The call binding is restored with the demo run's residual project facts corrected, and the project brief is lifted from the FIELDWISE master draft so Phases 1-2 have a project to analyse. The operator input pack (items 2 and 7, decided/confirmed 2026-08-11) is the authority for the project-scoped corrections.

selected_call_deviation.what: selected_call.json is not carried forward byte-for-byte, deviating from the original ticket criterion ('carried forward unchanged'). Call-scoped fields are carried forward unchanged from the pre-purge file (recoverable at commit 6d96a60). Six project-scoped fields are corrected, because the pre-purge file mixed genuine call facts with the superseded demo run's project facts, and two of its internal references dangle after ticket 1 archived their targets to decision_log/archive/demo-run/. Carrying it forward unchanged would reintroduce purged project data into Tier 3 and produce a file with broken references — what §13.11 exists to prevent. The operator input pack item 7 sweep verified both points against the pre-purge file and called this a purge miss, not a criterion collision.

corrected_fields.project_duration_months: 24 -> 30. Operator decision of 2026-08-11 (input pack item 2): 24-month European Fellowship plus a 6-month non-academic placement at AgroVIR under CC-07.
corrected_fields.project_duration_months_note: Cited '13B consolidation, 2026-07-16' (the superseded run) -> cites input pack items 2 and 7.
corrected_fields.project_duration_note: Asserted 'project_duration_months = 24' -> states 30 and that 24 + 6 is the composition. Stale the moment the field above changed.
corrected_fields.host_country_note: Cited '13B consolidation, 2026-07-16' -> cites input pack item 7. Value HU is unchanged and still correct; only its provenance was superseded.
corrected_fields.action_confirmation_ref: decision_log/action-confirmation-msca-pf_2026-07-13.json (dangling; ticket 1 archived it to archive/demo-run/) -> null, with action_confirmation_status Unresolved and a note naming ticket 7. The ticket table's corrected value is 'the FIELDWISE authorisation record from ticket 7'; that record does not exist yet, and naming a not-yet-written path would replace one dangling reference with another. Null-pending-ticket-7 is the honest realisation: ticket 7 writes the FIELDWISE authorisation record and fills this field. No runner predicate reads it, so the pending state blocks no gate.
corrected_fields.notes: Claimed the spine and RQ1-RQ10 are 'operator-confirmed real data (13B consolidation)' and cited an archived decision-log path -> restates the spine from input pack item 7, records that RQ1-RQ10 and the DATA_PROVIDERS record are superseded by the draft (which carries RQ1-RQ7 and H1-H6), and carries the C5 conditionality on HOST and FELLOWSHIP_TYPE.

unchanged_on_purpose.max_project_duration_months: Stays 36. A genuine call fact — the call-level maximum across both fellowship types — not the project's duration. runner/unit_cost_budget.py documents the distinction and refuses to substitute one for the other.
unchanged_on_purpose.project_duration_status: Stays Confirmed, now accurately: the operator decided the duration on 2026-08-11. Set here rather than declared in working_assumptions.json because gate_09 accepts either route but phase_04_gate's timeline_within_duration reads project_duration_months from this file by name, and an unavailable predicate value is recorded as a special case rather than a pass. Setting it satisfies both gates.
unchanged_on_purpose.host_country: Stays HU. FIELDWISE also hosts at ELTE, Hungary.

project_brief_lift.status_rule: plan §5: draft text -> Confirmed; derivation -> Inferred; no draft basis -> Assumed (declared); missing/contradicted -> Unresolved. Everything in this slice is Confirmed against cited draft paragraph ranges; nothing not present in the draft is marked Confirmed.
project_brief_lift.paragraph_numbering: Defined and anchor-checked in hand_lift_provenance.json (436 non-empty paragraphs including table cells; §1.1.8 at ¶80, §3.2 at ¶424 — matching the plan's citations).
project_brief_lift.duration_not_duplicated: project_summary.json deliberately carries no duration record. The 30-month duration is an operator decision, not a draft fact; its single authoritative home is selected_call.json.
project_brief_lift.no_person_named: The brief files name organisations the draft names (ELTE, MATE, MVCRI, AgroVIR) but no person. The fellow and supervisor identities enter Tier 3 at tickets 5 and 6 from the confirmed spine, not from the draft, which never names them.

spine_conditionality: Input pack item 7 confirms the identity spine, with HOST and FELLOWSHIP_TYPE conditional on the deferred C5 mobility-eligibility question. selected_call.json notes carry that conditionality; ticket 7 must resolve C5 or list it as Unresolved in the authorisation packet before authorising any phase run.
extended_by: Ticket 4 (architecture inputs) and ticket 5 (consortium) extend hand_lift_provenance.json and this lift record's scope as their slices land.

extensions.what: Second seeding slice: the six architecture_inputs files, lifted from the draft under the same §5 envelope and status rule.
extensions.confirmed_content: O1-O6 (§1.1.8 table), WP1-WP5 with month ranges, leads, 32 tasks and 14 deliverables (§3.1), MS1-MS5 (months 6/12/16/20/23), 13 risks with split L/I and mitigations (§3.1 risk table), five §2.3 impact claims, six §1.1.9 transitions and the validation ladder.
extensions.inferred_content: The output/outcome separation the draft lacks (OC1-OC6, derivations in note); task-level months (each task inherits its WP month range — no sub-range is guessed); six inter-WP dependency edges derived from WP content, milestone statements and the validation ladder.
extensions.unresolved_content: Person-months (workpackage_seed.json) and KPIs plus the EI-03/EI-04/EI-06 expected-impact mappings (impacts.json). The operator answered input pack items 5 and 8 on 2026-08-11, but folding answers into Tier 3 is ticket 6's scope; seeding them here would blur the lift/fold boundary the ticket structure draws. Nothing is invented (§13.3).
extensions.operator_added_deliverable: D1.3 Career Development Plan (due M3, FELLOW + SUPERVISOR, reviewed M6/M12/M16/M20) is seeded into WP1 and outcomes.json outputs per the ticket 2 correction: CC-13 requires the plan as a deliverable and the draft's D1.1-D5.5 list has none. Source: operator input pack item 6, accepted 2026-08-11 — an operator decision, not draft content, and cited as such.
extensions.d13_status_reasoning: D1.3 is marked Confirmed, not Assumed, as a deliberate narrowing of the plan §5 rule ('no draft basis -> Assumed'). That rule guards against content nobody decided; D1.3 is an explicit operator decision (input pack item 6, accepted 2026-08-11), the same footing on which ticket 3 marked the 30-month duration Confirmed in selected_call.json with the tickets file's sanction ('Confirmed is honest now that you have decided it'). §12.2's 'named source in Tier 1-3' is satisfied prospectively: ticket 6 copies the completed input pack into Tier 3 source_materials, at which point the citation is in-tier. Both D1.3 records carry checklist_ref CDP_DELIVERABLE, which ticket 6's re-authored confirmation_checklist.json must resolve. Declaring it Assumed instead would require a working_assumptions.json declaration that ticket 6 owns, and would misstate the epistemic state: the fact is decided, not adopted for want of evidence.
extensions.tests: tests/runner/test_fieldwise_ticket4_seed.py pins the acceptance criteria (envelope, statuses, Confirmed sets, Inferred derivations, Unresolved person-months/KPIs, provenance coverage, dependency_normalizer compatibility).

co_supervisor_deviation.status_reasoning: Confirmed as an operator decision, on the same footing as ticket 4's D1.3 and ticket 3's 30-month duration, with the one open check named in the record: his primary employment must be ELTE rather than HUN-REN, because MSCA requires supervision at the beneficiary. The check blocks no gate.

input_pack_correction.what: Input pack item 1 states that AgroVIR's confirmed-absent PIC makes phase_03_gate predicate g04_p07 fail. It does not.
input_pack_correction.evidence: g04_p07 is all_partners_in_tier3 in runner/predicates/coverage_predicates.py. It compares the set of lead and contributing partner ids in wp_structure.json against the partner ids in partners.json, resolved as partner_id then id then short_name. It reads no PIC, no legal name and no participation mode.
input_pack_correction.consequence: VALIDATION_PARTNER is present, so g04_p07 passes on token membership even while the record stays Unresolved. The absent PIC blocks submission instead: AgroVIR hosts the non-academic placement, so it goes in Part A, where every participant needs a PIC. The correction is written into the VALIDATION_PARTNER notes in both consortium files and belongs in the ticket 7 authorisation packet, which should not carry a gate failure that will not happen.
input_pack_correction.unchanged: Item 1's substantive answer stands. The PIC is confirmed absent and only the EU Participant Register can supply it.
